items.title: The Roth IRA Mistake That Turns $4,775 a Month in Tax-Free Dividends Into a Tax Bill
items.summary: Switching Roth IRA custodians looks like routine paperwork, but one wrong choice can pull your tax-free nest egg out of its shelter for good. Find out which transfer method protects the money before you request that check.

items.title: 3 High-Yield Storage REITs Are Rallying After Raising Their 2026 Outlooks

items.title: Sitting on a $1.45 Million IRA at 61? The Roth Conversion Math That Turns Future RMDs Into $7,250 a Month Tax-Free
items.summary: A big traditional IRA hides a tax bill the IRS will eventually force you to pay. One window of quiet years before RMDs begin could shrink it, but a Medicare surcharge two years down the road can punish the wrong move.

items.title: Self-Storage REITs All Grow NOI for First Time Since 2024
items.summary: Fading new supply and longer customer stays pushed all four public self-storage REITs to same-store NOI growth in Q3, a first for TractIQ.

items.title: Three Megamergers Closed This Year, and $120,000 Across the Combined Companies Pays $5,050 a Year
items.summary: Kimberly-Clark swallowed Kenvue, Public Storage absorbed National Storage Affiliates, and two apartment REITs fused into one. Now each board decides what shareholders get paid, and the integration costs, debt loads, and dilution warnings tell very different stories.
